mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (sympathomimetic stimulant) combined with scopolamine (anticholinergic) creates opposing effects on autonomic nervous system with potential for cardiovascular instability and CNS overstimulation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor closely for tachycardia, hypertension, mydriasis, urinary retention, and CNS excitement; consider alternative anticholinergic or ADHD agent.
